mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO recipe_ingredient ( recipe_id, ingredient_name, quantity, unit, is_main, display_order, category_id ) VALUES
( #{item.recipeId}, #{item.ingredientName}, #{item.quantity, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{item.unit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{item.isMain}, false), #{item.displayOrder}, #{item.categoryId, jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, recipe_id AS recipeId, ingredient_name AS ingredientName, quantity, unit, is_main AS isMain, display_order AS displayOrder, category_id AS categoryId FROM recipe_ingredient WHERE recipe_id = #{recipeId} ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
